hero.title: SERVICES BUILT FOR BRANDS THAT NEED TO BE SEEN, HEARD, AND REMEMBERED.
hero.subtitle: From design and print to film, photography, audio, digital campaigns, and studio training, Tripod turns ideas into production-ready creative work.

intro.title: Twelve services arranged like one production wall.
intro.body: Each zone uses one strong media frame, numbered services, and a direct route into the brief without collapsing into tiny cards.

designBrand.title: DESIGN & BRAND
designBrand.body: The front wall of the studio: identity, visual language, and print-ready execution.

visualProduction.title: VISUAL PRODUCTION
visualProduction.body: Film, stills, aerial coverage, and live delivery arranged as one capture system.

soundStudio.title: SOUND & STUDIO
soundStudio.body: Recording, production, podcast sessions, and training held on one studio desk.

digitalGrowth.title: DIGITAL GROWTH
digitalGrowth.body: Digital support stays connected to the campaign, not detached from the studio.

graphicDesign.title: Graphic Design
graphicDesign.description: Bold layouts, campaign graphics, and brand surfaces ready for rollout.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Identity direction built to make the brand feel clear and memorable.

printing.title: Printing
printing.description: Posters, packaging, and physical campaign pieces prepared for production.

photography.title: Photography
photography.description: Portrait, product, and event stills captured for campaigns and archives.

videography.title: Videography
videography.description: Cinematic coverage, edits, and branded motion built for screens.

droneCoverage.title: Drone Coverage
droneCoverage.description: Aerial coverage that expands the story and scale of the shoot.

liveStreaming.title: Live Streaming
liveStreaming.description: Multi-camera signal support for launches, events, and live moments.

audioRecording.title: Audio Recording
audioRecording.description: Clean recording sessions for voice, music, and creative direction.

musicProduction.title: Music Production
musicProduction.description: Beats, arrangement, and studio shaping built around the final sound.

podcastRecording.title: Podcast Recording
podcastRecording.description: Voice-led sessions with a studio setup that keeps the conversation sharp.

digitalMarketing.title: Digital Marketing
digitalMarketing.description: Content systems and rollout strategy built to carry the campaign further.

instrumentTraining.title: Instrument Training
instrumentTraining.description: Practical training that connects rehearsal, confidence, and studio discipline.

process.title: From brief to delivery on one studio timeline.
process.body: This section stays close to a Tripod production board: clear stages, disciplined numbering, and a handoff that keeps direction intact.

steps.title: Brief Lock
steps.description: We set the message, audience, deliverables, and production priority.

steps.title: Creative Direction
steps.description: References, formats, timing, and visual or sound direction are aligned.

steps.title: Production / Design / Record
steps.description: Cameras, layouts, print prep, or studio sessions move on one board.

steps.title: Edit / Print / Package
steps.description: Assets are refined, exported, printed, or prepared for campaign use.

steps.title: Launch / Deliver
steps.description: The final work is handed over ready for posting, screening, printing, or rollout.

digitalSupport.title: DIGITAL SUPPORT CAN FOLLOW THE CAMPAIGN WITHOUT TAKING OVER THE PAGE.
digitalSupport.body: If the campaign needs a landing page, content system, or launch support, we can connect it after the core production path is clear.
digitalSupport.label: DIGITAL SUPPORT

cta.title: BRING YOUR NEXT PROJECT INTO THE STUDIO.
cta.body: Start on WhatsApp with one service, one production zone, or the full brief. We will route it into the right studio path.

featuredDevelopment.title: ONE BRIEF. MULTIPLE DISCIPLINES.
featuredDevelopment.description: One campaign can need design, stills, video, live coverage, audio assets, and rollout materials. This is where Tripod works as one connected production desk instead of separate vendors.
